name: probe

name: screencopy-probe
description: Summon the Quickshell screencopy feasibility probe (criterion 5)

name: bar-reveal
description: Reveal the hidden bar while Super is held (QBAR-08). Explicit `release: false` — this entry claims the PRESS edge only. The RELEASE edge of the same chord is a separate, pre-existing Hyprland bind (tap Super -> main menu, keybinds.lua), and the two never collide because keybind-doctor's chord-collision check compares the edge, exactly as its shadow check always has.

name: notif-centre
description: Toggle the notification centre (Phase 19 Plan 06, D-19-16, QNOTIF-06) — repoints the outgoing daemon's own Super+N chord onto this shell's own GlobalShortcut.

name: power-menu
description: Toggle the in-process session/power dialog (Phase 20 Plan 06, QPOWER-01, D-20-22) — repoints the retired GTK4 power-menu surface's own Super+Shift+Q chord onto this shell's own GlobalShortcut (that surface RETIRE-05-deleted, Phase 20 Plan 10).

name: media
description: Open the dashboard directly on the Media tab (Phase 21 Plan 07, D-21-12, QMEDIA-01) — restores reachability for the retired standalone media card's own opener (RETIRE-06), which died with the Phase 18 bar retirement (RETIRE-02, 21-BEHAVIOUR-BASELINE.md D-01) and has had no live caller since.

name: settings
description: Toggle the in-shell QML settings window (quick task 260820-sqd, PD-02, D-02/D-06) — a FloatingWindow toplevel, not a layer surface. `comma` measured free under both SUPER and SUPER+SHIFT on this host 2026-08-20; `S` was not used because it is taken under both modmasks.
